Set --dmp-pulse-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Paywall Funnel
note: A five-stage Sankey whose ribbons keep one path structure in every state, so rescaling it (absolute from visitors, the wall or the offer, or each step at 100% so every continuing ribbon becomes a magnifying lens), range and source all transition the CSS d property on a linear() spring; the offer test computes log-ratio 95% intervals and a z-test from raw counts for a forest plot and a guarded ship flow. Set --dmp-paywall-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Audience Retention Replay
note: Retention curves are built from per-second hazards (hook, chapter changes, sponsor break, credits) and annotated automatically with the steepest exits and the replay bump; a rAF playhead replays the audience over a DPR-aware canvas waveform, pausing off screen via IntersectionObserver, and the completion rings animate a registered @property through @starting-style. name: Ad Yield Floor Lab
note: Each slot replays 2,400 seeded second-price auctions, so the bid histogram, the revenue-per-request curve against the floor, its optimum and the page RPM (impressions per pageview times revenue per request, summed over slots) all come from one sample; slots in the article template are buttons whose fill is mixed in oklch from a --v custom property. name: Byline Attribution Board
